items.title: Legendary composer Frank Klepacki says the RTS genre isn't dead, but he would like to see devs get a little more creative with it
items.summary: Klepacki shared his thoughts on the state of the real-time strategy genre in the latest issue of Edge.

others.title: GTA 6 Reviews: When They Could Be Released

content.v: Frank Klepacki has composed a lot of great game music over the years—in fact, he's responsible for the soundtrack in Eye of the Beholder 2, one of the best dungeon crawlers of all time . At heart, though, Klepacki is a real-time strategy guy—and he takes real issue with claims that the genre is dead.

There's no question that RTS is diminished, at least compared to its glory days. Back in the 1990s, games like Command & Conquer, Warcraft, and Dune 2 ( especially Dune 2, I'd say) dominated the scene. But all that remains of any of them these days is the seemingly unkillable World of Warcraft—and how many players even know that Blizzard's one true behemoth is an RTS spinoff?

Speaking in the latest issue of Edge, however, Klepacki said he thinks the genre still has lots of life in it. "There was all of this doom-and-gloom talk about ten years ago, saying, 'Oh, we think RTS is dead now—why are you still trying to work on games that are in a genre that’s going away?’" Klepacki said. "Obviously, if there are games coming out, [the genre is] not going away. It’s just that other types of games have taken the forefront of attention. Everything runs in cycles, you know? That’s how it always is."

That's true: RPGs have ebbed and flowed over the decades, and flight sims were huge until they weren't, and then they were again. But Klepacki also pointed the finger at a hollowing-out of the industry and growing aversion to risk, particularly among big-budget developers: "I would love to see more unique ideas that are allowed to be triple-A titles. A lot of indie titles are taking those creative chances, but a lot of the middle ground has gone."

Real-time strategy DNA has persisted in the MOBA genre, but traditional RTS games are enjoying a bit of a boom too. More than 20 years after Frozen Throne, Blizzard dropped a new campaign for Warcraft 3 in September, a Game of Thrones RTS is in the pipe, and Company of Heroes and Ruse are back; Age of Empires and Age of Mythology are still rumbling along, Tempest Rising delivers a very C&C-like experience, and while the new StarCraft game revealed at BlizzCon is a shooter, Blizzard is still dicking around with StarCraft 2 , too.
The days of building them around ensemble Hollywood casts may be over (at least for now), but the RTS itself? Be happy, Frank: it's definitely alive and kicking.

items.title: PS1 Classics on PS5 Keep on Coming in Dino Crisis 2, Out Next Week
items.summary: But don't expect Trophies. Capcom classic Dino Crisis 2 will be made available on PS5 and PS4 via the PS Store

content.v: But don't expect Trophies.

Capcom classic Dino Crisis 2 will be made available on PS5 and PS4 via the PS Store from next Tuesday, 20th October 2026. The game will be part of PS Plus Premium straight away, but it'll also be purchasable outside of the subscription, most likely for £7.99 / $9.99.

This will be a port of the PS1 version, but it'll ship with the bells and whistles of Sony's classic conversion process, such as rewind features, video filters, and quick save options. However, you shouldn't expect Trophy support: Capcom's own classic titles that have been ported to PS5 and PS4 unfortunately haven't come with any Trophy lists.

content.v: 围绕《使命召唤：现代 战争 4》登陆Switch2，ComicBook作者认为，这款游戏可能缩小任天堂与PlayStation、Xbox在第三方游戏阵容上的差距。任天堂过去主要依靠自家作品吸引玩家；如果重要的第三方系列也进入其平台，玩家选择主机时的考量可能改变。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261015/1792010442_858126_jpg_r.jpg
《使命召唤》系列曾在Wii推出多部作品，但受硬件条件限制，这些版本在画面和功能上与同期其他主机版本存在差距。系列随后在Wii U推出《使命召唤：幽灵》，此后多年未再登陆任天堂平台。作者因此将《使命召唤：现代战争4》的Switch 2版本视为系列回归的关键案例。
作者还指出，便携性是Switch 2相较其他主机的一个特点。结合任天堂现有的第一方作品，以及其他准备登陆Switch 2的第三方作品，作者认为，如果第三方阵容持续扩大，任天堂与PlayStation、Xbox之间的竞争可能更复杂。不过，玩家是否会选择在Switch 2购买《使命召唤：现代战争4》，目前仍没有答案。

content.v: 近日彭博社记者Jason Schreier透露，《GTA6》游戏内置一套动态出汗系统，主角杰森与露西娅的出汗量，会跟随跳舞的卖力程度发生实时变化。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261015/1792010681_336045_jpg_r.jpg
这套机制并非固定预制贴图，角色的流汗状态会根据身体消耗的体力动态调整。在夜店场景中，跳舞动作越激烈，角色皮肤的汗渍效果就越明显，汗水光泽、湿润效果都会随之改变，甚至连头发也会呈现出出汗带来的湿润质感。
Schreier表示这类看似微小的视觉细节，同样消耗了大量开发资源，这也从侧面解释了本作开发周期漫长的原因。不止跳舞，这套出汗系统会作用于各类体力活动，角色进行高强度行动后，都会出现对应的流汗视觉反馈，进一步强化 开放世界 的沉浸感。
作为R星打磨多年的大作，《GTA6》在环境、角色身体反馈等大量细碎系统上投入大量精力，力求让虚拟世界的行为反馈更加贴近现实。目前官方尚未公布该系统全部触发条件，更多相关细节还需要等待后续进一步披露。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: R星与被解雇员工及IWGB工会有关的劳动仲裁将延续至11月。法院新增11月17日、18日两天庭审，供双方律师作结案陈词；案件目前尚无最终裁决。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261015/1792010124_940642_jpg_r.jpg
庭审原计划在本周五结束，但证人询问所需时间超出预期。R星方面的律师要求更多时间交叉询问部分被解雇员工，IWGB也仍在询问Rockstar方面的证人，因此结案陈词尚未进行。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261015/1792010126_128680_jpg_r.jpg
这起争议源于R星在2025年末解雇逾30名员工。这些员工都曾出现在一个工会Discord频道中。IWGB认为解雇针对工会活动；R星则表示，解雇涉及未经授权的信息分享。双方说法仍是仲裁审理的争议焦点。
新增庭审日期与报道提到的《GTA6》发售日相近。双方仍需完成结案陈词，案件结果有待后续程序。

content.v: 《塞尔达：时之笛 重制版》Switch 2版本出现了哪些变化？IGN一名作者试玩超过一小时后，整理出与N64原版相比观察到的29处改动。这并非完整清单，内容涉及迷途森林、大德库树内部、海拉鲁平原、城下町和森林神殿，也包含原版谜题与迷宫的剧透。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261015/1792010054_798216_jpg_r.jpg
早期流程中，林克的钱包初始容量为200卢比。取得科奇里之剑的挑战改为跳向房间中央较高的平台，森林商店旁新增了讲解防御的训练靶。大德库树内的蜘蛛敌人则需要先用剑打转，才会露出弱点。
探索时，疑似藏有入口的地面裂痕提供了更直观的线索。城下町允许玩家自由控制视角，也能从入口连续走到时之神殿。

此外，作者注意到更多角色对话，以及可供参考的任务记录、物品界面变化和能够实时施放的迪恩之火。

content.v: R星在开发《GTA6》时，曾讨论买啤酒、做三明治该让玩家完成哪些步骤，以权衡 开放世界 的写实程度与游玩节奏。游戏仍以允许玩家实施各类犯罪的讽刺性开放世界为基础，团队希望玩家更能融入环境，同时避免日常操作过于繁琐。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261015/1792009935_412174_jpg_r.jpg
讨论包括：买一箱啤酒时，是否要先从酒铺冰柜取货，再到柜台结账；制作一份能提升角色属性的三明治时，是否必须先去超市买食材。这些都是开发阶段考虑过的流程，尚不能据此认定它们会出现在正式版中。
彭博社记者指出，团队讨论这类细节时，游戏许多部分尚未完成，相关决定需要不断摸索。开发负责人Phil Hooker表示，到2022年，项目仍有大量工作要做，但一些局部内容已开始显现整体方向。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261014/1791985049_976090_jpg_r.jpg
从R星目前展示的内容来看，游戏中人物会回应主角Jason和Lucia的行为。两名主角之间设有关系系统，既可以发展浪漫关系，也可以保持伙伴关系。Rob Nelson表示，玩家在游戏世界中不会始终无人能敌，环境可能对他们的行动作出敌意回应。
《GTA6》将于11月19日发售，登陆PS5和XSX|S平台。

content.v: 近日Polygon作者试玩了约30分钟的Switch 2版《塞尔达传说：时之笛》重制版。他认为，新增的手动跳跃与奔跑让移动和探索更敏捷，游戏也保留了原作的氛围。试玩涵盖开场、大德库树内部、海拉鲁平原、城下町，以及成年林克探索森林神殿的部分流程。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261015/1792009869_828029_jpg_r.jpg
开场流程中，林克现在可以按键手动跳跃。作者认为，取得初期装备、拾取和投掷物品、应对简单战斗时，动作都较迅速且准确。获得道具后，玩家还能用按键循环切换副武器与物品，减少操作停顿。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261015/1792009871_687054_jpg_r.jpg
前往城下町时，新增的奔跑能力让林克更快穿过宽阔的海拉鲁平原。主菜单中的冒险记录会提示故事进展和下一处目的地，作者认为这有助于玩家重新接上剧情。城下町则有来往的人群、交谈及可探索的支线机会。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261015/1792009873_985874_jpg_r.jpg
进入森林神殿后，作者注意到藤蔓、苔藓、纹理、光照和贴地雾气营造出的古老气氛。他认为，视觉处理让神殿各区域更容易区分，调整后的建筑细节也使空间显得更真实，同时保留了原作特色。受试玩时间限制，他尚未见到神殿头目。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: Epic计划通过新版Epic Games启动器将《堡垒之夜》带到Linux。启动器预览版已首次面向Linux推出，但游戏目前还不能在该平台运行，关键前提是完成反作弊系统的适配。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261015/1792009804_102447_jpg_r.jpg
Epic表示，正在重建Easy Anti-Cheat，并与Linux发行版维护者讨论安全要求。相关方案能够与足够多的发行版维护者配合运作后，公司才会通过启动器提供《堡垒之夜》。这些改进未来也将开放给其他开发者使用，帮助他们将游戏带给Linux玩家。
Easy Anti-Cheat本身已有Linux支持，但《堡垒之夜》此前仍未支持该平台，其中涉及在多种内核配置下应对作弊的顾虑。Epic计划先在《堡垒之夜》中试用新版Linux反作弊方案，目前没有游戏Linux版的推出时间表。
Epic也在研究与基于Linux的SteamOS兼容，但表示没有计划将《堡垒之夜》上架Steam商店。Steam Deck目前尚不具备新版反作弊方案所需的功能，Epic正就此与Valve沟通。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/thumbnews/20260720/1784518943_551412.jpg

content.v: Epic Games已开放新版游戏启动器的预览下载，首次将支持范围扩展至Linux，同时覆盖Windows和macOS。Epic称新版游戏库的载入速度达到旧版的30倍。预览版仍处于早期阶段，现有功能较少。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261015/1792009701_523526_jpg_r.jpg
这次更新重写了启动器外壳、下载管理、游戏库，以及商店中的游戏发现和商品详情等部分。目前，预览版可使用商店、游戏库、社交面板和面向虚幻引擎开发者的页面。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261015/1792009703_567416_jpg_r.jpg
Epic提供的测试数据显示，新版启动器冷启动约需5.47秒，从系统托盘重新打开约需0.36秒，程序体积约为300MB。上述速度数据来自Epic的测试，实际体验可能因设备而异。界面方面，用户可以调整顶部标签顺序，并按类别筛选游戏库；Epic表示，后续还将改进游戏发现和玩家之间的推荐分享功能。
Linux版启动器开放预览，并不意味着《堡垒之夜》已能在该平台运行。Epic表示，仍需先完成相关反作弊系统的适配。

content.v: R星开发负责人Phil Hooker解释了《GTA6》此前延期的原因：游戏的不同部分未能按原定时间顺利组合，并非开发中出现了某个重大突发问题。他在接受彭博社采访时表示，游戏没有一份始终固定不变的开发蓝图，团队近几个月仍在调整部分内容。
https://img.3dmgame.com/uploads/images/news/20261015/1792009662_195130_jpg_r.jpg
Hooker还以一次试玩说明游戏世界中的互动。他原本打算前往剧情任务，却先在路上与汽车相撞，随后进入便利店补充恢复生命值的物品。他因一名非玩家角色的言语与其发生冲突，又趁店员不在时抢劫了商店。
离开商店后，Hooker在警方追逐中弃车换车，又因为车辆的转卖价值和另一次碰撞继续偏离原定路线。按他的回忆，试玩约两小时后，他仍未接近最初要去的剧情任务。这是他描述的一次具体试玩经历，正式版本中的相关互动范围仍有待确认。
此外，R星在洛杉矶设立了一个专门制作NPC(非玩家角色)的工作室。

items.title: GTA 6 Was Originally Meant to Release Much Sooner Than We Realized
items.summary: Rockstar Games has revealed that it originally intended to develop GTA 6 alongside Red Dead Redemption 2, mean

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/09/17/gta-6-soundtrack-1789662158949.jpg
Rockstar Games has revealed that it originally intended to develop GTA 6 alongside Red Dead Redemption 2, meaning it probably would've come out much sooner than we ever realized.

As told in a new article from Bloomberg , Rockstar Games initially planned to develop Red Dead 2 and GTA 6 at the same time, but that quickly became infeasible. Rockstar North co-studio head Rob Nelson recognized that the ambition behind Red Dead Redemption 2 meant they would need to treat it as an all-hands-on-deck situation, which also meant putting GTA 6 on the back burner. However, GTA 6 would benefit from this, as Nelson noted to Bloomberg that everything they built for Red Dead would "pay off" in GTA 6.

That appears to be true, as GTA 6 uses a lot of ideas and systems from Red Dead Redemption 2, including its NPC interaction system. It seems unlikely that GTA 6 would be what it is today if it had stayed the course and been developed in tandem with the western sequel. Unfortunately for fans, it means the game took much longer to make. Had it been developed simultaneously, it seems likely that Rockstar would've been able to release GTA 6 in the early 2020s.

Of course, the first release window that Rockstar ever actually publicly provided for GTA 6 was 2025. The game was delayed a couple of times, much to the bewilderment of Strauss Zelnick, the CEO of Rockstar's parent company, Take-Two Interactive. Rockstar's head of publishing Jennifer Kolbe noted that she had to call Zelnick just months after announcing the game's first delay to inform him that they would need more time.

“I think he said, ‘You’re kidding. Please tell me you’re kidding,’” recalled Kolbe to Bloomberg. “But once we talked through why, he got it. And I think we are really lucky that he is as reasonable as he is, because a lot of people would say, ‘You’d just better figure out how to ship it.’ And we have been really, really lucky that we have not found ourselves in that place, because that happens to a lot of teams, and we’ve all played those games. It’s not great.”

Bloomberg's report dispels rumors that GTA 6 has been in active development since shortly after GTA 5 was released in 2013, but that doesn't mean Rockstar only began working on it after Red Dead 2's launch. Various teams and leadership within Rockstar have been researching and planning GTA 6 since as early as 2014. Rockstar has spoken at length in recent interviews about taking staff to Florida to research and dream up ideas for GTA 6 during the mid to late 2010s.

Bloomberg noted that the team didn't have a "skeleton" for GTA 6's story until the end of 2019, a year after Red Dead 2's release. Even then, it took a while before the team was able to fully wrap its head around what the game would be. Rockstar has vowed to not take nearly as long on its next game , thanks to the fact it seems to have fewer obstacles going forward.

Rockstar doubled in size during GTA 6's development, encountered multiple leaks, had a loss in productivity during the pandemic, and much more. The studio also made major changes to how it operates and expects that will set it up for success moving forward. What is Rockstar's next game? We don't know. Some may expect Red Dead 3, but other fans are hoping that Rockstar will break the cycle of alternating between Red Dead and GTA in favor of something new or reviving a different IP. Whatever the case is, don't expect it to take another eight years.

items.title: Epic 正在彻底改革其反作弊机制，以便《堡垒之夜》最终能够登陆新平台
items.summary: Thanks to devices such as the Steam Deck and Steam Machine, as well as the ongoing issues with Windows, gaming

content.v: Thanks to devices such as the Steam Deck and Steam Machine, as well as the ongoing issues with Windows, gaming on Linux looks a lot more attractive over the last few years. Its biggest hurdle is still multiplayer games and their anti-cheat systems, but Epic Games is committed to bringing one of the biggest around to the operating system soon.

Epic Games has announced that it is working on a Linux version for Fortnite. It's going to act as a test for Epic's overhaul of EAC (Easy Anti-Cheat) , its solution to those developing multiplayer games in Unreal Engine to prevent cheating (most recently used in Gears of War: E-Day). Epic says that it has offered Linux support for its current version of EAC, but that most developers (itself included) opted not to use it and instead omit Linux support entirely because of its inability to be as protective as its Windows version.

A native rebuild of EAC, that doesn't require translation layers such as Proton, would help Epic bring the software up to par with Windows, at which point it would be comfortable finally releasing a native Linux version of Fortnite. In a blog post, Epic says that once it has reached this stage, it will make this available to other developers, too.

"We are also planning to pilot EAC Linux v2 in Fortnite first, where we’ll test it in a live environment and refine it based on what we learn. Once we’ve validated EAC v2’s effectiveness, we’ll make it available to more game developers so they can bring their multiplayer games to Linux players too."

Epic hasn't shared a timeline for when it expects Fortnite on Linux, but does say that its pilot program will be available through its new Epic Game Store launcher . Announced at the same time, Epic has decided to follow through with its commitment to AI-developed software earlier this week, with the new launcher labelled as "vibe coded" because "programming is hard". This version is still in preview and lacks all of the features currently on the main version of the store launcher, but Epic says that it is already seeing some speed improvements (even if they're just a few seconds here or there).

That might be too steep a price to pay depending on your appetite for linking your credit card details to an app that is being iterated on without much (or any) human intervention. And it's already led to some strange bugs that certainly would've been caught without being rushed into the hands of users.
Earlier this week Epic Games reportedly delayed a Star Wars/ Marvel crossover title as the company pivots towards an "AI-first" production model that does away with "hand-written code."

items.title: Xbox Survey About Exclusives Includes A Nuclear Strategy, But Wait Just A Minute
items.summary: Microsoft is reportedly surveying a subset of Xbox users about changing its plans for exclusive games going fo

content.v: Microsoft is reportedly surveying a subset of Xbox users about changing its plans for exclusive games going forward--possibly in a big way--and that's no surprise given Xbox CEO Asha Sharma has alluded to changes to the exclusivity strategy in the future .

At the same time, a survey like this is not necessarily indicative of anything beyond Microsoft conducting research. After all, there is an entire team at Xbox called Xbox Research that ... researches all manner of things, and the results of that research doesn't always lead to changes in the marketplace.
Windows Central reports that a new survey was issued to some Xbox Insiders this week, and the site confirmed the survey to be real.
The survey asks how members might feel about the totally nuclear option of making all Xbox-developed games except Call of Duty exclusive to Xbox on console.
"Imagine it was announced that all future title releases from every Xbox-developed gaming franchise except Call of Duty will be console-exclusive to Xbox," the survey asks.

It goes on: "For Minecraft only, existing titles would no longer be available for purchase on PlayStation or Nintendo consoles and would not receive any new content updates. However, there is no impact to any of the existing titles or content you already own. Nothing changes on PC with this announcement."
The survey asks respondents to say in this scenario, where they would be most likely to play any of the exclusive content. The choices are:
Another page of the survey specifically asks about Fallout, polling users about how they would feel if future Fallout games would be console-exclusive to Xbox, and with nothing changing at all on PC.
Windows Central reported that the survey also asked these same questions about The Elder Scrolls, Doom, Physint, Diablo, and Minecraft.
In a memo to staff, Sharma and Xbox boss Matt Booty said they will “re-evaluate” the approach to exclusivity , which could mean a lot of things. Surveying fans is likely connected to this endeavor.

Fans have called on Microsoft to return to exclusive games, but it remains to be seen if that will happen. Sharma and Booty also said they will consider changing things up in regards to “windowing,” which followed on from a report that said some other games beyond Call of Duty titles could be kept out of Game Pass at launch and for a period of time, similar to how movies are only available in theaters at first before coming to digital and streaming.

The so-called nuclear option of making all non-Call of Duty first-party games exclusive to Xbox on console would indeed be a bonafide return to exclusivity, but it also seems quite unlikely given how much money Microsoft could miss out on. At the same time, Sharma has pledged to fans that that Xbox needs exclusives to return to growth as part of the big Xbox "reset."

A survey like this offers an inherently hypothetical scenario, and it could simply be part of Microsoft's fact-finding mission to get a pulse of the fanbase. It would be an entirely different thing for Microsoft to commit to exclusives in this way and invest meaningfully to do so.
Sharma's other efforts so far as the new Xbox CEO have included mass layoffs, studio closures, and game cancellations. She has also said Microsoft's big bet on Game Pass did not work .

items.summary: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 releases on November 19, but when will you be able to read reviews? According to

content.v: Rockstar's Grand Theft Auto 6 releases on November 19, but when will you be able to read reviews? According to historical precedent and a new report, reviews for the open-world crime game should be available before launch.
Insider Gaming reported that reviews for GTA 6 will be posted at some point before November 19, but the exact timing is unknown for now.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Ambrosia_06_e19462.jpg?w=636
What history tells us

The last GTA game, GTA 5, was released on September 17, 2013, and reviews for the game were published starting on September 16. For Rockstar's next game, 2018's Red Dead Redemption II, reviews also went live one day prior to release.
This doesn't necessarily mean Rockstar will follow the same playbook for GTA 6, however. Nothing is confirmed at this stage.

GTA 6 launches on November 19-- unless it's delayed again --for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. It's expected to be the biggest game of 2026 and maybe all time, and it's reportedly on pace to earn $2 billion in revenue before launch .

A lot of new details about GTA 6 recently came to light, including how the game originally had a bigger scope and could have launched sooner , Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick’s response to a big delay , and the absurd amount of detail in the game .

We also learned that GTA 6 did not in fact cost $1.5 billion to make and that an entire studio was spun up to create NPCs . Rockstar also discussed how its GTA 6 realism experiment began with beer and sandwiches and that the studio says it won’t need another eight years to release its next game. Beyond all of this, Rockstar reacted to the game's high-profile hack in 2022.

items.title: Invincible VS Players Can't Get Enough of Atom Eve's 'Thicc' Casual Skin
items.summary: Atom Eve got a Casual costume in Invincible VS and, to no one’s surprise, the show’s fanbase is going feral fo

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/14/invincible-vs-thicc-eve-skin-1792003110388.jpg
Atom Eve got a Casual costume in Invincible VS and, to no one’s surprise, the show’s fanbase is going feral for it.

If you’re familiar with Invincible at all, you’ve probably seen some discourse online surrounding Atom Eve’s weight gain in the show and comics. We won’t spoil anything for you in this article, but it’s a byproduct of a major story beat in the source material, and her transformation is often looked on fondly by fans — if not outright preferred over her slimmer design.

The devs at Skybound Games have been hard at work developing new characters and costumes for Invincible VS , the show’s tie-in 3v3 tag fighting game, most recently unveiling Angstrom Levy as a playable character… but the big brainiac isn’t who’s got players talking right now.

Alongside this character, Skybound also released a few alternate costumes for its other characters, including a ‘casual’ outfit for Atom Eve. And while she’s certainly dressed down, it’s her weight gain that’s got the fanbase in a tizzy.
It’s safe to say that everyone’s pretty thirsty for this particular version of Eve, with one excited player writing , “We ALL copping Everyday Eve, right?”
“Invincible better be able to fight,” another joked .
“The people yearn for thicc Eve,” yet another said .
A new Invincible VS Skin for every Casual Friday, Dressed Up Weekend, and Duct-Tape Wednesday. https://t.co/qxdCVwCWBA

Still others are pleasantly surprised that the devs at Skybound chose to go in this direction for Eve’s alternate costumes, given that body diversity isn’t something seen very often for female characters in fighting games (though this is a trend that’s changing in more recent releases, with Marisa in Street Fighter 6 being a good example).

Invincible VS is leaning into the memes with its costumes and characters lately; Skybound also gave Mark a Duct-Tape Man costume (leaning into a ‘superhero costume’ he made in his childhood) and even including Agent Spider as a playable fighter, a character who’s basically a riff on Marvel’s Spider-Man, for all intents and purposes.

Invincible VS released earlier this year. IGN scored the game a seven out of 10 , with our reviewer Mitchell Saltzman saying its “hard hitting and fast paced 3v3 tag fighting is a gust of fresh air, especially for those who miss the two-way interactable combo system of Killer Instinct.”

The next season of Invincible is scheduled to release on Prime Video in early 2027. The show has been renewed for a sixth season, as well, becoming the platform’s longest-running animated series to date.

items.title: GTA 6 泄密者用“死人开关”威胁 Take-Two
items.summary: Cyberleek promises not to reveal the ending of GTA 6, as long as Take-Two leaves them alone.

content.v: It's a classic move: A villain, or sometimes a hero, inserts himself into a seemingly inescapable situation. Danger everywhere—no way out! But just as the good guys (or bad guys) are about to pounce, he holds up the pin he's pulled from the grenade under his coat, forcing everyone to back off! Escape is at hand!

That seems to be the strategy now adopted by notorious Grand Theft Auto 6 leaker Cyberleek, and by "seems to be," I mean they stated it outright. In a message posted to their now-defunct website but preserved by GTA VI News on X , Cyberleek committed to not releasing anything more about GTA 6—including its ending, which at this point remains unknown—as long as Take-Two lets everything slide.

"CL has the ending. It was considered," the message states. "It would punish Take-Two greatly—but ruin the experience for the gamers, who did nothing wrong. Take-Two would show CL no mercy—why should CL show any to them? Still: Take-Two was punished enough.

"The ending stays unpublished. Proof: the latest leek—clips from the final missions, out of context, revealing nothing. The dead man's switch is active—story spoilers only. Left alone, it never fires. Whoever removes CL chooses it."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/tq5sm4PPdFDjLzdxf2ody7-1920-80.jpg

A dead man's switch, generally speaking, is a switch built to be triggered if its operator is incapacitated. Miles Dyson, for instance, blew up Cyberdyne Systems with an improvised dead man's switch in Terminator 2 (not that it did much good) and Roger Murtaugh did the literal grenade-pin thing in Lethal Weapon while trying to save his daughter from Shadow Company goons. There are variants—in Point Break, for instance, Rosie was ordered to kill Johnny Utah's girlfriend if Bodhi didn't check in by 3, to ensure Johnny's participation in a bank robbery.
My own personal favorite dead man's switch comes from Hawk the Slayer:
That particular variation on the theme notwithstanding, dead man's switches are meant as last-ditch failsafes: If something bad happens to me, something much worse will happen to you .

It makes me wonder if Cyberleek's sudden withdrawal and proposed détente with Take-Two means that they're starting to feel the heat. Take-Two takes this sort of thing seriously as a matter of course, and you can bet it's going to go extra-hardass on anyone who messes with its biggest game ever, which GTA 6 unquestionably is. I have no doubt that life for Cyberleek will become very unpleasant, very quickly, if and when they're ever caught.

The problem Cyberleek faces, of course, is that their leverage—assuming it's real in the first place—has a very short shelf life. In six weeks at most, the GTA 6 ending will be out there, at which point there will be no shot left to shoot.

At best, then, this threat grants Cyberleek an extra month to find a deeper hole to hide in. And even that is wildly optimistic: Take-Two might be operating quietly, but I have no doubt that it's also operating furiously, and that there's not much of a mood to play 'I won't if you won't' games.

Cyberleek also defended their cryptocurrency ask, saying it "was always a donation, never an investment," and denying that a rugpull happened; they also said they wouldn't release the full build of GTA 6, with "full story mode, played to the end," because their memecoin market cap didn't hit $30 million .

items.title: Ace Combat Zero gets its own standalone app on Steam, freeing it from the 136GB install of Ace Combat 8
items.summary: The biggest complaint about the pre-order bonus game is getting resolved with a happy ending.

content.v: Ace Combat 8 rocks. PC Gamer's reviewer scored it a 92% , and I've been savoring the campaign, because I know it could be years until we get another bombastic flight sim melodrama of its kind. Although I do have another Ace Combat lined up to play after: Ace Combat Zero, which was included as a free pre-order bonus with AC8, and subsequently responsible for the majority of the new game's negative launch day reviews.

Not because Zero is bad—it's a series fan-favorite—but because Bandai Namco inexplicably bundled it into the AC8 launcher, meaning you can't download this 3.2GB port of a 2006 PS2 game without the 136 gigabytes of Wings of Theve. This decision was not well received .

But now there's a happy ending: in an update on the Steam page on Tuesday, Bandai Namco announced that Ace Combat Zero "will be made available as a standalone application on Steam." That doesn't mean it will be made available for purchase: Zero was a pre-order bonus, so only those who bought Ace Combat 8 ahead of launch will have it in their Steam libraries. No change there. You'll just be able to download and launch it independently if you already own it. It's currently going through "final quality assurance and compatibility testing" ahead of the split.

The biggest benefit from the change (aside from potentially freeing up 136GB of precious SSD space) is that Zero will now support Steam Cloud saves. Judging by the nearly 400 comments on the post in less than 24 hours, the news has gone over very well—though there are also quite a few requests for the standalone Zero to include achievements, which were part of the console release.
There's no date given for Zero's emancipation, but presumably it won't be too far off.

items.title: Retro Handhelds Loaded With Unlicensed Games Could Face Government Crackdown
items.summary: The Electronic Software Association (ESA) has a serious bone to pick with retro handhelds that are packaged wi

content.v: The Electronic Software Association (ESA) has a serious bone to pick with retro handhelds that are packaged with tons of unlicensed pre-installed, calling these devices "superfakes" that should face some sort of suppression by the US government.

According to an October 6 filing with the Office of the United States Trade Representative (USTR)--which monitors marketplaces that are accused of engaging in or enabling piracy and counterfeiting--the ESA is urging the government to clamp down on what it calls "illicit plug-and-play consoles and handheld devices." The ESA wants the USTR to add these emulation devices to the Notorious Markets List, the agency's annual report identifying which markets are participating in such behavior, thereby barring or slowing their profits.

"In the video game sector, illicit plug-and-play consoles and handheld devices are the functional equivalent of superfakes," the ESA told the USTR. "They can look and feel like legitimate, mass-market consumer electronics: molded housings, color displays, polished user interfaces, retail packaging, product reviews, warranty-like representations, and listings on familiar e-commerce platforms. Yet their commercial appeal rests solely on a concealed memory card or internal drive loaded with hundreds, thousands, or even tens of thousands of unauthorized copies of copyright-protected games."

The ESA puts a specific spotlight on Anbernic , a console manufacturer that sells 3DS- and Game Boy-looking devices packed with thousands of games from systems like the NES and SNES to the PlayStation 1 and Sega Genesis. Though maybe the most prominent example, another one that comes to mind is rapper Soulja Boy's various console attempts .

The filing also targets digital marketplaces that it says distribute or sell modded accounts and pirated games such as Eldorado, FunPay, G2A, and Voices38. In short, the ESA is seeking some kind of restitution for the harm that "superfake" retro consoles pose to the gaming industry writ large.

"A single device can substitute for lawful purchases across multiple video game publishers and console generations, divert sales from authorized games, compilations, subscriptions, remasters, and licensed retro hardware," the ESA wrote. "Because the product is often delivered with an immediately usable catalogue of pirated games, it removes the technical friction that once separated mainstream consumers from video game piracy. Sellers commonly use the illicit library as a key selling point, and the commercial price often reflects this."

items.title: I've given GTA 5's cars Bond-style ejector seats
items.summary: Going up.

content.v: I'm modding GTA 5 every day in a quest to either transform it into a PC version of GTA 6 or break it entirely. Come back tomorrow to find out what new horrible thing I've done to Rockstar's baby, or check out what I got up to earlier .

Following my experience being abducted by a small yellow taxi , something has become clear to me: I need a means to escape. The trauma of my kidnapping experience cannot be repeated. I have installed Eject for Grand Theft Auto 5, a mod that lets you punch out of vehicles at a moment's notice.

"A simple little fun script that allows you to eject from vehicles and parachute down," reads the mod's description—a claim which is 50% true. You can, indeed, eject from vehicles at the push of a button, but the parachuting down part is more of a screaming plummet. We make do.

The mod's defaults are relatively anaemic. Its "Force" setting sits at a measly 150. 150 what? No idea, but that's a small number, so I immediately increased it to 10,000. I also tried increasing it to 100,000, which seemed to crash the game on launch.

And then, off I went, sailing through the streets of Los Santos in my shiny car in the night (sometimes in the day) and whacking the eject key to hop out. The mod has not quite mastered preservation of momentum, so my attempts to, for instance, leap across an overpass and land safely back in my car, met mostly with failure. And by mostly I mean entirely.
Still, it did let me do this, so I'm calling it a mixed success.

Back when I was a lad, I spent quite a lot of time at my local video store – remember those? It was located smack bang between my childhood home and high school, so my friends and I would often stop by and pick up a few snacks while perusing VHS tapes and DVDs. It was here that I first glimpsed the horrific visage of Pinhead — or The Hell Priest — Hellraiser ’s overarching antagonist.

I didn’t get around to actually watching the Hellraiser series until a few years later, and I’ve still yet to watch later entries like Revelations and Judgment (you can’t have Pinhead without Doug Bradley, I’m sorry), but those first few films were genuinely terrifying. The notion of demonic beings who, unable to distinguish between pleasure and pain, take humans to a labyrinthine dimension to be tortured for eternity still sends shivers down my spine.

items.title: Gears of War: E-Day Mod Adds Halo, Star Wars, and Warhammer 40,000 Skins
items.summary: A Gears of War: E-Day mod lets players fancast your own team of Gears, with options from everything from Halo

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/14/incursion-1791992648253.png
A Gears of War: E-Day mod lets players fancast your own team of Gears, with options from everything from Halo spartans to Space Marines from Warhammer 40,000.

Incursion, from game designer Tom Whaley, aka @Unreal_Dev on X / Twitter , adds a skin selector to E-Day that lets you deck out Marcus, Dom, Mags, and Lucas in various skins. In addition to Halo and Warhammer options, there are Clone Troopers from Star Wars and even some in-universe appropriate Gears skins. You simply choose the skins from the new option in the main menu, or from the pause menu in-game.
What would #Halo made by The Coalition look like? https://t.co/G66T9FB0nj

The Incursion mod streamlines what’s usually a multi-mod setup for this kind of thing. Once you’ve got it installed, you can flip between skins at your leisure without needing to manually swap files or reinstall different character mods. While there are few limitations, you’ll of course need a copy of Gears of War: E-Day to run the Incursion mod pack. Check out the page on Nexus Mods for instructions on installation.

Last week, Alinea Analytics' head of marketing analysis, Rhys Elliott, reported that E-Day had sold an estimated 230,000 copies in its first week in what was described as a soft start. These unofficial figures, which are not backed by data provided by Microsoft, pointed to Xbox subscription service Game Pass as cannibalizing sales.

Earlier this month, the boss of The Coalition responded to reports that staff at the studio were worried they might lose their jobs amid the ongoing cuts at Xbox, promising the next Gears game wouldn’t take as long to make. Presumably future games will see the return of meat shields and chainsaw duels, features that were conspicuously missing from Gears of War: E-Day at launch. This is a direct consequence of the developers making the game from scratch, rather than using previous games in the series as a foundation.

items.title: Looking back on 10 years of Overwatch, the promises kept, and where Team 4 goes from here
items.summary: "In order for people to play the game in the present, they need to have confidence in its future."

content.v: 10 years is a long time for anything, but for a live service game it's a milestone that very few are able to cross. Overwatch made it over the line earlier this year, and has since been able to do something of a victory lap because after all the highs and the lows, Overwatch is in the best place it's ever been .

"It doesn't feel like 10 years to me," game director Aaron Keller tells me. "Although, I could probably answer that question in a few ways. There's probably a year or two that might have felt like five or six years in the middle of this process, but there's always so much to be doing on the team and for the game." But Keller reiterates the good old adage "if you love what you do, you never work a day in your life.
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/xdcPtestjJHLDAJEgWhDeR-1920-80.jpg

"Our team is filled with people that are not just passionate about making games, they're passionate about Overwatch itself, our heroes and the world in which they reside. So when you get to go into the office and talk about that all day, the time can fly by pretty quickly."

Alec Dawson, associate game director, joined before the launch of Overwatch 2 but also feels as if these last four years have flown by "in a blink of an eye … It's wild that when we started the year, we had these silhouettes of heroes that we didn't even know what they were going to be, what they were going to look like, and now we do," Dawson adds. "Sometimes it just goes by much quicker than you think it's going to."

Overwatch has undergone many metamorphoses, some good, others not so good. We had the early golden years, then we had GOATS, then a plethora of some of the best game cinematics ever, then we had early Brigitte taking a literal hammer to the game's balance.

After something of a content drought, excitement was renewed with the announcement of Overwatch 2, and while this did offer a lot of good changes like more heroes, content, and focused team fights in 5v5, it failed to meet the requirements of a sequel , and that's without the disappointment surrounding PvE .
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/8tACEUQZmSoZq4PiuBwHVJ-1920-80.jpg

There was a time when I thought that was it for Overwatch, that PvE and Overwatch 2 would be all anyone would ever talk about. But I've never been happier to be proven wrong, because all these years later Overwatch is going from strength to strength experimenting with things like perks and Stadium, tweaking the user experience with map voting and hero bans, and changing to a new annual content release format.

"I don't think we could honestly say we knew it would go this far," Keller says. "I believe that there's always been something special about Overwatch. There's something special about the world. This optimistic, hopeful take on the future. I do think that there's something special about the gameplay—it's so crisp and clean—and there's moments you have in Overwatch that you just don't really get to have in other games."

I've said it before but the current success that Team 4 is seeing didn't just happen overnight . It's been a long road, one marked with deliberate decisions and remedies taken by its devs. The passion the devs have exhibited, the humility to admit when things aren't working, and keeping player's best interests at the forefront are why the game is in such a good state today.
What promises have Team 4 kept over the last 10 years?
Next up

Moving on from its tenth anniversary year, Overwatch has a new seasonal cadence which has not only worked to spark excitement, but as Keller sees it, has bolstered the "belief that Overwatch is really going in a good direction." There's a steady flow of quality-of-life changes to its UI as we saw last season with new heal, burn, and team indicators. Team 4 has given players more freedom when it comes to picking Drives, and the narrative story is back to being central to Overwatch's experience.

There's obviously going to be a steady flow of new content and characters, but Dawson has also confirmed that map reworks and tweaks will be "something we want to continue doing". Informed by map voting and community feedback the team will ensure that reworks "can stand on its own" not only fixing problems but gunning for a better overall experience: "I think our next rework does a pretty good job of that."
https://cdn.mos.cms.futurecdn.net/NQfwNpKnFqE3StyLVtegAJ-1920-80.png

"We're really far into development on Season 1 for 2027," Keller reveals. "We're talking about what Season 1 is going to look like in 2028, and getting started on that. We want it to feel like not just one big moment but that the game is fresh for players and that we are getting players to look at it through new eyes again—we want to do it in a different way each year."

But while Team 4 gets stuck into planning content for the years to come, Dawson stresses that their overall mission will stay the same: "As much as the industry has changed, games have changed, genres, etc. Overwatch is still home for so many people. It's a really big responsibility that we take to heart of making sure that Overwatch can be a part of those people's lives as long as possible.

"To make sure they have the game and the heroes that they can relate to, make sure that they can play with their friends, and just keep having that place where they feel like, okay, this is where I want to be. This is where I want to spend my time. This is where I want to make memories. Hopefully, we can keep carrying that into the future as well."

items.title: 前《守望先锋》总监杰夫·卡普兰表示，他从来不想成为聚光灯下的焦点，但游戏需要一张面孔
items.summary: Being the face of a video game is a demanding role, as the people who step into these positions involved in th

content.v: Being the face of a video game is a demanding role, as the people who step into these positions involved in these roles often find themselves on the receiving end of a lot of toxicity. Former Overwatch game director Jeff Kaplan knows this all too well, as he promoted the hero shooter for several years and regularly interacted with its fans--albeit at a "personal cost."

After leaving Blizzard Entertainment in 2021, Kaplan has been quietly working on The Legend of California , the in-development game at his new studio, Kintsugiyama. Reflecting on his time as the face of Overwatch, Kaplan spoke to GameSpot about how Overwatch needed someone to fill that role. For Kaplan, this was part of Overwatch's growth and continued existence, and he felt it was needed at the time.

"This is going to sound ridiculous, but I'm not someone who likes attention," Kaplan said of his time in the public-facing position. "I'm not much of an extrovert. I don't have a heavy social media presence. And so, a lot of me putting myself out there when I was at Blizzard was sort of to serve my game and my team--doing a job and a role."

Overwatch--and Blizzard as a whole--has had tremendous highs and lows over the years. During periods of content droughts or Hero changes, players would often target Kaplan and other developers on the game with verbal abuse and threats. There has never been a silver bullet to eliminate player toxicity, but Blizzard discovered that dropping a ton of content into Overwatch helped change player sentiment .
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/OW-heroes.png?w=636

While his departure from Blizzard back in 2021 wasn't easy, Kaplan said that being freed of the responsibility of being associated with Overwatch and fading into the background turned out to be "pretty great" in the end.

"There were a lot of emotions mixed up in leaving Blizzard, but one of the things that was sort of much needed for me, on a personal level, was that withdrawal," Kaplan said. "To stop reading the subreddits, to not talk to anybody. It's not like I had a game that I needed to talk to anybody about, and I don't have the need to see my name in headlines or, you know, like, 'Let's Google and see where I'm being mentioned today.' That's just not me as a person. So, it was very soothing to my soul to sort of fade into the background and just put all of that aside for some time. It was pretty great, actually. It was very needed for me."

Kaplan went on to explain his thoughts on if studios even need a public face for their games, citing both Valve and Rockstar as companies that "do a great job of promoting their games" despite not having a designated speaker.

"There doesn't need to be [one]," Kaplan said. "But I think it was good for Overwatch to sort of let the players know, 'We're one of you, we're listening.' It showed a level of transparency and engagement, like, 'Hey, this thing is being made by real people.' Blizzard always runs the risk of kind of, 'Oh, it's just a nameless, faceless corporation' if we don't put ourselves out there.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/jeff-kaplan-stop-complaining-about-games-you-wont-play-shut-v0-cn4TnuirbR-XdIZHUsXZfXWaEtggzJmlo7eT0qk_b08_662b5b.webp?w=636

"I think people like [current Overwatch director] Aaron [Keller] or myself, kind of [thought], 'Hey, we should really let these people know: We play the game too. We have opinions too.' That was sort of the strategy, but it comes at a cost to you personally. I know a lot of extroverts who love it and are like, 'I just did press for eight hours, and I feel energized!' And I'm like, 'Oh my god, I need to hide under a rock for seven days because I did one interview.'"

Currently, Kaplan and the rest of the team at Kintsugiyama are working on The Legend of California, a multiplayer survival-action game set in the wild west. The title doesn't have a release date yet, but if you're interested in taking part in an upcoming playtest for the open-world shooter, you can check out its Steam page and request access.

items.title: Xbox Nano 控制器发布，而且它非常小
items.summary: Microsoft has announced a new controlled called the Xbox Nano Controller, and it's smaller than the existing X

content.v: Microsoft has announced a new controlled called the Xbox Nano Controller, and it's smaller than the existing Xbox controller, and it costs less.

Microsoft says the controller is designed to fit nearly every pocket and budget. "Its compact design offers a great option for younger players, smaller hands, or anyone seeking something portable for play on the go," the company said.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Screenshot-2026-10-14-at-12.03.35-PM-1.png?w=636

The Xbox Nano controller is a bit over five inches in length and weighs 3.5 ounces--it's the smallest controller Microsoft has ever made. It features all 18 gameplay buttons you'd expect, so Microsoft says it should feel familiar.

The smaller controller comes with a smaller price, too: $50 USD. Microsoft partnered with Samsung on a bundle that comes with a controller and two months of Game Pass Ultimate (for new subscribers) when they buy a new Samsung TV this holiday. For anyone planning to use this new controller for cloud streaming, Microsoft will soon put caps on how much you can play before you must pay more to keep going .
Additionally, Microsoft and Facebook company Meta are working on a new bundle featuring the Nano controller, two months of Game Pass, and a Meta Quest headset.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Screenshot-2026-10-14-at-12.09.09-PM.png?w=636
The Xbox Nano controller uses rechargeable batteries and a programmable action button for quick access to things players want, like taking a screenshot or capturing gameplay.
https://www.gamespot.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/10/Screenshot-2026-10-14-at-12.09.23-PM.png?w=636
You can preorder the Xbox Nano controller now . The Nano was the second new gaming controller revealed today, following Sony's announcement of a limited-edition DualSense controller for Gran Turismo.

items.title: Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced was a big hit, and now it's time for big layoffs at the studio that made it
items.summary: Ubisoft has also decided to close Trials studio Ubisoft Redlynx entirely.

content.v: Three months after the very successful launch of Assassin's Creed Black Flag Resynced , a game that sold two million copies in a single day ( three million copies in a week!) and surpassed "annual expectations" in just two weeks, Ubisoft has laid off 70 people from developer Ubisoft Singapore. In a statement provided to PC Gamer, the publisher also said it plans to close the Ubisoft Redlynx studio outright.

This would be reason number two on our list of 25 foolproof ways to get laid off in the videogame industry: Make a game that sells so well, it blows away all expectations and makes even more money than anyone dared hope.
Of course, we've already seen this in play with Black Flag Resynced—Ubisoft Barcelona, a support studio on the game, had nearly a third of its number cut shortly after it launched.

The Ubisoft Barcelona layoffs might seem particularly egregious, coming so soon after it produced a much-needed win for a publisher that's spent the past few years taking big Ls , but it's not the only bad news.

A year after announcing a " restructuring proposal " for Ubisoft Redlynx aimed at reducing costs and ensuring "a stronger prioritization and efficiency across the company’s worldwide studio network," Ubisoft has now decided to close the studio outright.

Founded in 2000 and acquired by Ubisoft in 2011, Redlynx is best known for the Trials motorcycle racing games, the last of which— Trials Rising —came out in 2019. Since then, the studio supported the development of Star Wars Outlaws and released the mobile game Gwen's Getaway; a VGC report says Ubisoft decided to close Redlynx because it's not currently working on anything else, and downsizing wouldn't make it sustainable anyway.
Ubisoft acknowledged "the contributions" of the employees being put out of work in its statement, and said it will conduct the process "with care and respect."

items.title: Spawn Gets 7-Inch Warlock Diablo Immortal Deluxe Action Figure - Fall FanFest 2026
items.summary: IGN Fan Fest is kicking off today, and as part of the celebration, we’re showing off a Spawn Warlock action fi

content.v: https://assets-prd.ignimgs.com/2026/10/13/diablo-immortal-spawn-figure-1791922260266.jpg
IGN Fan Fest is kicking off today, and as part of the celebration, we’re showing off a Spawn Warlock action figure that commemorates the anti-hero’s special collaboration with Diablo Immortal.

As revealed at Blizzcon 2026 , Diablo Immortal is currently in the midst of a crossover event with Spawn, which runs from September 29 to November 1. This month-long extravaganza features a slew of new Spawn-themed challenges, abilities, and of course, a Spawn-themed cosmetic set.

The Warlock class version of this skin set is coming to the real world in the form of a 7-inch deluxe action figure from McFarlane Toys. Designed with ultra articulation and up to 22 moving parts, this figure has a full range for making cool poses. It includes a wired fabric cape, the Hellspawn Subjugator Sacrificial Blade, Demon Skull, and four alternate hands.
This figure also comes with an Elite Points card, which can be redeemed on the McFarlane Rewards website to snag rewards and one-of-a-kind prototypes, as well as a collectible art card.

Perhaps the most standout feature of this figure is Spawn’s wired cape, which manages to bring McFarlane’s signature, larger-than-life style to reality. The devil is in the details here (no pun intended), with every bit of in-game armor represented in the figure’s model.
Pre-orders are available now at McFarlane Toys’ official website and select retailers for $49.99. The figure is set to release in March 2027.

Diablo is having a big moment right now; on top of Immortal’s Spawn collaboration, Diablo V was announced at this year’s Blizzcon, which is scheduled for release in 2029. An animated show is also in the works at Netflix, though not much is known about the project at present.

We got the chance to interview the developers behind Diablo V to talk about the game, who confirmed that development is already in full swing. You can check out our conversation here , where they told us why this upcoming game is set 100 years in the future after Diablo IV and why they decided to announce the project so early.
